name: CareerFind India - Daily 8:00 AM AI Job Collection Workflow

nodes.name: Fetch Permitted Open Remote Tech Feed

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "contents": [
    {
      "parts": [
        {
          "text": "You are a strict data extraction AI for CareerFind India job portal. Analyze this job content and output ONLY a JSON object conforming to this schema:
{
  "title": "string",
  "company_name": "string",
  "category_slug": "it-software | data-analyst | ai-machine-learning | network-engineer | software-developer | non-it-jobs | government-jobs | work-from-home | internships | btech-fresher-jobs | walk-in-interviews | graduate-trainee",
  "location": "string",
  "work_mode": "In-Office | Hybrid | Work From Home | Remote",
  "job_type": "Full-Time | Part-Time | Internship | Contract | Walk-In",
  "experience_level": "Fresher | 0-2 Years | 2-5 Years | 5+ Years",
  "experience_min": 0,
  "experience_max": 2,
  "salary_text": "string (or 'Not Disclosed' if not mentioned)",
  "qualification": "string",
  "skills": ["string"],
  "description": "string",
  "responsibilities": ["string"],
  "eligibility_criteria": ["string"],
  "application_deadline": "YYYY-MM-DD or null",
  "official_apply_url": "string",
  "is_fresher": false,
  "is_government": false,
  "is_wfh": true,
  "is_internship": false,
  "is_walkin": false
}
CRITICAL: Never invent missing information. If salary is absent, set salary_text to 'Not Disclosed'. If deadline is absent, set application_deadline to null.

Job Content:
Title: " + $json.title + "
Company: " + $json.company + "
URL: " + $json.source_url + "
Details: " + $json.raw_content
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "generationConfig": {
    "responseMimeType": "application/json",
    "temperature": 0.1
  }
}

main.node: Fetch Permitted Open Remote Tech Feed
